command:
set -u
printf 'boot_id=%s\n' "$(cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id)"
printf 'cron_active=%s cron_enabled=%s\n' "$(systemctl is-active cron)" "$(systemctl is-enabled cron)"
printf 'policy_sha256='; sha256sum /etc/cron.allow | awk '{print $1}'
printf 'policy_lines='; paste -sd, /etc/cron.allow
if [ -e /etc/cron.deny ]; then printf 'cron_deny=present\n'; else printf 'cron_deny=absent\n'; fi
for test_user in root opsadmin nobody; do
  out_file=$(mktemp)
  runuser -u "$test_user" -- crontab -l >"$out_file" 2>&1
  rc=$?
  if grep -qi 'not allowed' "$out_file"; then result=DENIED; else result=ALLOWED; fi
  printf 'crontab_access user=%s result=%s exit=%s message=' "$test_user" "$result" "$rc"
  tr '\n' ' ' <"$out_file"
  printf '\n'
  rm -f "$out_file"
done
getent passwd opsadmin
